item.title: M&S Launches Nutrient Dense Meals to Help Shoppers Get More Fibre and Vitamins
item.description: Marks and Spencer has launched a new Nutrient Dense food range aimed at helping people boost fibre, vitamins and minerals, as figures show most UK adults are missing key nutrients despite growing interest in healthier eating.The post M&S Launches Nutrient Dense Meals to Help Shoppers Get More Fibre and Vitamins appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Police Scotland Seize Nearly £80 Million Worth of Drugs During 2025
item.description: Police Scotland seized nearly £80 million worth of drugs during 2025, including major recoveries in Aberdeen and across Scotland, as officers continued efforts to disrupt organised crime and protect communities from harm.The post Police Scotland Seize Nearly £80 Million Worth of Drugs During 2025 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Year of Pride and Progress for Streamline Shipping Group
item.description: Streamline Shipping Group has reflected on a landmark year supporting major events, pioneering autonomous drone deliveries and strengthening community support across the Highlands and Islands, as the logistics firm looks ahead to further sustainable growth in 2026.The post A Year of Pride and Progress for Streamline Shipping Group appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Amber Snow Warning Issued for North Scotland as Travel Disruption Likely
item.description: An amber snow warning has been issued for parts of the Highlands and Eilean Siar, with heavy snowfall, drifting and possible blizzard conditions forecast, raising the risk of travel disruption, power cuts and rural communities becoming temporarily cut off.The post Amber Snow Warning Issued for North Scotland as Travel Disruption Likely appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Oasness Make Thunderous Debut at An Seomar With Electrifying First Gig
item.description: Oasness made a thunderous debut at An Seomar in Inverness with a confident and electrifying first gig, delivering a note-perfect tribute to Oasis that had the crowd bouncing, singing and fully onside from the opening moments.The post Oasness Make Thunderous Debut at An Seomar With Electrifying First Gig appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Festive Filers Sleigh Their Self Assessment Returns as January Deadline Nears
item.description: Thousands of people spent part of Christmas filing their Self Assessment tax returns, with over 4,600 submitted on Christmas Day alone, as HMRC urges customers to act early ahead of the 31 January deadline.The post Festive Filers Sleigh Their Self Assessment Returns as January Deadline Nears appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Lack of Fair Funding Puts Growing Strain on Scotland’s Voluntary Sector Workforce
item.description: New research has found funding insecurity is placing growing strain on Scotland’s voluntary sector workforce, with rising job insecurity, declining work-life balance and increasing workloads, prompting calls for sustainable multi-year funding ahead of the Scottish Budget.The post Lack of Fair Funding Puts Growing Strain on Scotland’s Voluntary Sector Workforce appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: NFU Scotland Calls for Scottish Food to be Put First in Schools and Hospitals
item.description: NFU Scotland is calling on the Scottish Government to reform public sector food procurement, warning schools and hospitals are missing a key opportunity to prioritise Scottish produce and support farmers, crofters and growers across the Highlands and Islands.The post NFU Scotland Calls for Scottish Food to be Put First in Schools and Hospitals appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Burgman 400 Proves Itself as an All-Season Highland Commuter
item.description: Built for Highland roads and weather, Suzuki’s Burgman 400 combines comfort, storage and traction control with a free winter-ready accessory pack, making it a true all-season commuter for riders across the north of Scotland.The post Burgman 400 Proves Itself as an All-Season Highland Commuter appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Police Urge Caution as Amber Snow Warning Issued for North and North East of Scotland
item.description: An Amber snow warning has been issued for the north and north east of Scotland, with Police Scotland urging motorists to avoid unnecessary travel as heavy snow, drifting and blizzard conditions threaten disruption across Highland communities.The post Police Urge Caution as Amber Snow Warning Issued for North and North East of Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.
